blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — No bettor won the over P370 million Grand Lotto 6/55 jackpot, which was one of the major lotto games drawn by the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) on Monday, Nov. 16, 2026. No one also won the MegaLotto 6/45’s P22.33 million jackpot on Monday’s draw. The Grand Lotto 6/55 winning combination was 11-43-32-26-52-09, with a jackpot prize of P373.62 million. No ticket matched all six numbers. READ: Lotto results for Nov. 16, 2026 The MegaLotto 6/45 draw produced the winning combination 13-22-41-43-26-45 for a jackpot of P22.33 million.
